headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty remained volatile as India VIX rose and crude prices stayed above $116 per barrel.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: GST collections surged 23% to ₹2.31 lakh crore in October due to festive demand boost.
Coal India production increased 19% as mining operations recovered after the monsoon slump.
The CCI approved the Devyani-Sapphire merger to unify KFC and Pizza Hut operations in India.
Syngene International expects a stronger second half driven by its order book and Zoetis supplies.
whatHappening: The market is closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Tuesday, 3 November.
Crude oil prices have stayed above $116, impacting market volatility in recent sessions.
Kia India reported record October sales with dispatches rising 13% year-on-year.
EPFO has introduced WhatsApp services and auto-settlement for accounts up to ₹1,000.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed for the weekend following a volatile session influenced by rising crude prices and global cues. Despite the volatility, strong GST collections and robust production data from Coal India provided fundamental support. Investors are now looking ahead to the Diwali week and upcoming corporate earnings for further direction.
